channel.title: The Hollywood Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hollywood Reporter (hollywoodreporter.com)

item.title: ‘John Rambo’: Noah Centineo’s Prequel Movie Rounds Out Cast as Production Begins
item.description: The Lionsgate feature tells the origin story of the character Sylvester Stallone initially played in 1982's 'First Blood.'

item.title: Tyler, the Creator to Perform at 2026 Grammy Awards
item.description: Tyler joins a star-studded performance list that also includes Lady Gaga, Sabrina Carpenter and Clipse.

item.title: Go Inside THR’s Studio in Park City — A Soft Landing for Stars Escaping the Festival Frenzy
item.description: Designed in partnership with luxury bedding brand Boll & Branch, the Studio offered A-listers a cozy, comforting reprieve from the chaos of Main Street.

item.title: ‘Cold Storage’ Review: Joe Keery, Georgina Campbell and Liam Neeson Make Goofy Sci-Fi Horror Throwback Painless, if Not Priceless
item.description: Directed by Jonny Campbell and adapted by David Koepp from his novel, the story of a frantic rush to stop a killer fungus from spreading also features Sosie Bacon, Lesley Manville and Vanessa Redgrave.

item.title: Ahead of High-Profile Negotiations, Writers Guild West’s Own Staff Union Authorizes Strike
item.description: Eighty-two percent of unionized staffers voted to empower leaders to call a work stoppage, just months before the labor group is set to face the likes of Netflix and Paramount.

item.title: Eva Longoria, John Leguizamo and More Latino Artists Sign Open Letter Urging for “Accountability and Equity” Amid ‘Deep Cuts’ Casting Backlash
item.description: The group of creatives acknowledged controversy that ensued after Odessa A’zion was cast in Sean Durkin’s A24 film as character Zoe Gutierrez, who is described in the book that the film is based on as half Mexican and half Jewish.

item.title: ‘Union County’ Review: Will Poulter and Noah Centineo Embed With Real-Life Recovering Opiate Addicts in Rural Ohio in Absorbing Docudrama
item.description: Adam Meeks expands on his short film of the same name in this debut feature integrating professional actors with court-mandated drug program participants.

item.title: ‘Melania’ Doc Premieres in D.C. as Director Brett Ratner Says $75 Million Price Tag “Wasn’t About Corruption”
item.description: The Amazon MGM Studios film, which follows the First Lady in the days leading up to Trump's second inauguration, debuted with support from the president and much of his cabinet.
